explanation: A polyp is the animal. A corallite is its skeletal cup, and corallum is the colony skeleton.
Angelfish have a strong preopercular spine. Colour and a compressed shape are not sufficient distinctions.
2.4 / 10 times 100 = 24%. This estimates cover, not colony count.
LiDAR emits laser pulses and measures the return. Passive methods depend on naturally available energy.
Halimeda is a calcifying green alga; its segments can contribute carbonate sediment.
7 minus 9 = -2, in the same mass/area/time units. The measured reef is erosional under those accounting assumptions.
The mechanism is reduced herbivory, greater algal competition, and reduced suitable settlement space.
Extreme refers to conditions; persistence is possible. Bleaching is not automatically death, marginal is not necessarily degraded, and positive feedback means amplification.
21 times 2 / 7 = 6 degree-weeks. The daily HotSpot is at least 1 degree, so it qualifies.
Adaptation is evolutionary change involving heritable variation. Acclimation is an individual physiological response.
Carbonate production, sediment delivery, waves, and geology make islands dynamic. Persistence is site-specific, not guaranteed.
Multiple functions measured over time are stronger evidence than planting numbers or an early image.
50 times 5 = 250 square metres. Use the whole width, not 2.5 m (one side only).
Size classes exclude spines, so differently long spines do not masquerade as different body sizes.
5 / 2 = 2.5. The inverse ratio is a different convention; the handbook wording is flagged.
6 times 4 = 24. Each source colony has one fragment in each of four temperature treatments.
The workbook uses score 3 as the ED50 response threshold. It is not a mortality fraction or direct symbiont count.
Solve 3 = -13 + 0.5T: T = (3 + 13) / 0.5 = 32 degrees Celsius.
The log-4 codes are abundance intervals, not raw counts. Code 4 represents 17-64 individuals.
A two-year turnover interval is 0.5 turnovers/year. Multiply 0.8 by 0.5.
Both can remove algae and carbonate; the balance differs. The lecture diagram is context-specific.
Manipulation tests a causal mechanism, although cage artifacts, controls and replication still matter.
Mg is a metric tonne. This is a stock, not yearly sequestration.
The reciprocal transplant separates environmental response from simply comparing native populations.
Convert total area to 25,500,000 ha, then multiply by 0.01.
40% stayed top quartile; 70% stayed top half. These are different cutoffs.
Selecting resistant colonies does not by itself edit their DNA.
Production is only one link; transport, deposition and retention determine island supply.
